message: Renovate proposes updates after 3 days (minimumReleaseAge: "3 days" in renovate.json), but pnpm waits 1 week (minimum-release-age: 10080 in .npmrc); its pull requests bring in versions younger than pnpm accepts, or fail where the lockfile is re-checked
fix: Make the Renovate delay at least 1 week, or run depcurfew apply
